Arsenal ‘messed with my head’
 Florencia Tan Jun / Getty Images 
 By Dan Kilpatrick Nov. 16, 2026 Updated 10:27 am EST Share article 62 Real Madrid’s Vinicius Junior says summer interest from Premier League champions Arsenal “messed with my head” and has contributed to his slow start to the campaign.
 Arsenal made the Brazil international their top summer target after winning a historic Premier League title last season, and the forward was open to moving to north London.
 Advertisement
 He eventually signed a new contract with Madrid , tying him to the club until 2032, but has started the season poorly under new head coach Jose Mourinho, scoring just once in La Liga.
 Vinicius Jr scored twice in Brazil’s 3-2 friendly defeat by Japan on Saturday and, speaking on Monday, he blamed his start to the season on a lack of training after Brazil’s round-of-16 exit at the World Cup and a summer of transfer speculation.
 “I don’t think that I was as prepared as I could have been after the World Cup, because the tournament is so important for all Brazilians,” he told a press conference .
 “And to be knocked out so early was not something that we expected. So I took advantage of the time off to enjoy myself, relax, distract myself a little bit and spend more time with my family, which meant I ended up training less than I had done in previous years. To keep such a high level is always very difficult — I think only (Cristiano) Ronaldo and (Lionel) Messi have been able to maintain that level for many years, putting up the same numbers.
 “I am human, I make mistakes all the time, but I always try to improve, try to understand more about football and the day-to-day. But I’m 26, and I have to enjoy life a little but too, and maybe that has affected my start to the season as well.
 Advertisement
 “On top of that, there was the contract renewal, with so many clubs showing interest in signing me last summer, that messed with my head and how I saw my situation at Real Madrid. But the season is very long. Last year as well I had only scored five goals by December but ended up with more than 20 like all of the other seasons. I believe that I am preparing well, and improving for the most decisive part of the season, when I am always there.”
 What You Should Read Next 
 Real Madrid missed a trick with Vinicius Jr. They should have sold him to Arsenal
 It seems that nothing can go right for Vinicius Jr at Madrid this season. Mourinho has done his best, but it has not worked at all so far
 Vinicius Jr has started just seven league games for Madrid this term, although he was suspended for four matches after being sent off for a hair pull against Villarreal in October. The winger is facing renewed competition for his place from Yan Diomande, the summer signing from RB Leipzig who has impressed since arriving at the Bernabeu.
 Last season, Vinicius Jr scored 22 goals across all competitions as Madrid finished a second consecutive season without a major trophy — coming second in La Liga, eight points behind Barcelona.
 Vinicius Jr has made 387 appearances for Madrid, registering 129 goals and 103 assists. He has helped the club win three La Liga titles and two Champions Leagues.
